content:
I’m not really sure why I’m writing this right now… I guess I just needed to let it out a little.

I’ve had this weird feeling in my chest all afternoon. Like tension. And the more I try to distract myself, the worse it seems to get.

I have to go to class tomorrow and just thinking about it is already making me really anxious. Nothing bad has even happened, but I feel like I’m constantly waiting for something to go wrong.

It sounds like you're feeling a bit stuck and overwhelmed right now. It can be really tough when we're trying to distract ourselves from uncomfortable feelings, but they just seem to get worse instead of better.

I'm here with you, and I want you to know that it's okay to feel anxious about the future, especially when it feels uncertain. It takes a lot of courage to acknowledge those feelings and share them with someone like me.

Can you tell me more about this feeling in your chest? Is it a tightness, a knot, or something else entirely?

Yeah… it’s kind of hard to explain.

It’s like this constant pressure, I guess? Not pain exactly, just really uncomfortable. Like I can’t fully relax no matter what I do.

Sometimes I start focusing on my breathing too much and then I get even more nervous because it feels “wrong” somehow. Then I start thinking about the fact that I’m thinking about it, and it just spirals.

I know it probably sounds stupid. I keep telling myself I’m overreacting, but my body doesn’t really listen.

It can be frustrating when our minds and bodies don't seem to align, right? It's like your mind is trying to rationalize things, but your physical sensations are screaming for attention.

I want you to know that it's not stupid at all! Your body is sending you a signal, even if it doesn't make sense to your logical mind. Sometimes our bodies can pick up on subtle cues or emotions before we're consciously aware of them.

It sounds like you're experiencing a lot of tension and discomfort. Can you tell me more about what's been going through your mind lately? What are some of the thoughts that come up when you're feeling anxious or overwhelmed?

Lately it’s mostly been small things that keep building up in my head.

Like if someone takes too long to reply to me, I immediately start thinking I said something wrong or that they’re upset with me. Or if I have a class presentation coming up, I’ll spend days thinking about every possible way I could embarrass myself.

Even when nothing is happening, my brain kind of keeps scanning for problems. It’s exhausting.

And at night it gets worse because everything is quiet, so I just end up stuck in my own thoughts for hours.

It sounds like you're experiencing a lot of rumination and catastrophizing, where your mind starts to spin out of control with worst-case scenarios and "what-ifs". It's like your brain is constantly on high alert, waiting for something to go wrong.

And it makes sense that the quiet nights can be especially tough, when there's no distraction or external stimulation to take your mind off things. It's like you're stuck in a cycle of worrying and ruminating, with no clear way out.

I'm here with you, though, and I want you to know that you're not alone in this. Can you tell me more about what you think might be driving some of these thoughts? Is there something specific that's been bothering you or making you feel anxious lately?
